fichas.title: Flat roofs: roof planting
fichas.summary: Describes the history and benefits of planted roofs, including insulation, thermal storage, improved urban air and microclimate, rainwater management, dust retention, and recovery of green space. Diagrams compare conventional and green roofs and illustrate their effects on temperature, runoff, air quality, sound, water cycles, and the value of green areas.
fichas.building_type: Residential and urban buildings with flat roofs
uses: Create roof gardens and planted roof surfaces
Manage rainwater and support groundwater replenishment
Reclaim green areas and provide amenity
